title: Vishvamitra ruins Vasishtha's hermitage
introduction: Vishvamitra ruins Vashishta's hermitage on acquiring missiles at the grace of God Shiva by practising a paramount ascesis. When the forces generated by Wish-Milker Sacred Cow, namely Kaamadhenu, have eliminated Vishvamitra's army and his hundred sons, he felt indignant and pray Shiva for bestowal of unusual missiles. On getting them, he again comes to Sage Vashishta's hermitage and ruins it completely. Then extremely infuriated Sage Vashishta resorts to his Brahma-baton to confront Vishvamitra.
closing: इति वाल्मीकिरामायणे आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे पंचपंचाशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 55th chapter in Bala Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
ततस्तानाकुलान् दृष्ट्वा विश्वामित्रास्त्रमोहितान् |
वसिष्ठश्चोदयामास कामधुक् सृज योगतः
verses.iast:
tataḥ tān ākulān dṛṣṭvā viśvāmitra astra mohitān |
vasiṣṭhaḥ codayāmāsa kāma dhuk sṛja yogataḥ
verses.translation: "Then on seeing the flurrying warriors earlier created by the Sacred Cow, Shabala, who are perplexed by the missiles of Vishvamitra, Vashishta started to motivate her, 'oh, wish-milker, generate more forces by your yogic capacity.' Thus Sage Shataananda continued his narration about the legend of Vishvamitra to Rama.

glosses.meaning: Vashishta, by missiles, those who are perplexed
started to motivate - in this way.

verses.devanagari:
तस्या हुंकारतो जाताः कांबोजा रविसन्निभाः |
ऊधसस्त्वथ संजाताः पह्लवाः शस्त्रपाणयः
योनिदेशाच्च यवनाः शकृदेशाच्छकास्तथा |
रोमकूपेषु म्लेच्छाश्च हारीताः सकिरातकाः
verses.iast:
tasyā huṅkārato jātāḥ kāmbojā ravi sannibhāḥ |
ūdhasaḥ tu atha sañjātāḥ pahlavāḥ śastra pāṇayaḥ
yoni deśāt ca yavanaḥ śakṛ deśāt śakāḥ tathā |
roma kūpeṣu mlecchāḥ ca hārītāḥ sa kirātakāḥ
verses.translation: "From the 'hums' of her mooing Kaamboja-s similar to sunshine are born, from her udder Pahlava-s wielding weaponry are born, from the area of her privates Yavana-s, likewise from her rectal area Shaka-s, and from her hair-roots Mleccha-s, Haariitaa-s along with Kirataka-s are issued forth.

glosses.meaning: Sun, similar in shine, Kaamboja-s, are born
from privates, area, Yavana-s, also - are born
from rectal, area, Shaka-s - are born
from hair, roots, Mleccha-s, also - are born

verses.devanagari:
तैस्तन्निषूदितं सैन्यं विश्वमित्रस्य तत्क्षणात् |
सपदातिगजं साश्वं सरथं रघुनंदन
verses.iast:
taiḥ tat niṣūditam sainyam viśvamitrasya tat kṣaṇāt |
sa padāti gajam sa aśvam sa ratham raghunandana
verses.translation: "At that very moment, oh, Rama the legatee of Raghu, Vishvamitra's army comprising foot-soldiers, elephants, chariots and horses is utterly slaughtered by the Yavana, Mleccha etc., forces generated by the Sacred Cow.

verses.devanagari:
दृष्ट्वा निषूदितं सैन्यं वसिष्ठेन महात्मना |
विश्वामित्रसुतानां तु शतं नानाविधायुधम्
अभ्यधावत् सुसंक्रद्धं वसिष्ठं जपतां वरम् |
हुङ्कारेणैव तान् सर्वान् निर्ददाह महानृषिः
verses.iast:
dṛṣṭvā niṣūditam sainyam vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā |
viśvāmitra sutānām tu śatam nānā vidha āyudham
abhyadhāvat susaṅkruddham vasiṣṭham japatām varam |
hum kāreṇa eva tān sarvān nir.hdadāha mahān ṛṣiḥ
verses.translation: "On seeing their army utterly slaughtered by the vital spirit of Vashishta, a band of hundred sons of Vishvamitra wielding divers weapons exasperatedly sprinted forth towards that supreme meditator among all meditators. But that great sage Vashishta completely burnt all of them down just by blasting 'hum' sounds.

glosses.meaning: by great souled one, by Vashishta
among meditators, supreme one, towards Vashishta
[that band of hundred sons] sprinted forth

verses.devanagari:
ते साश्वरथपादाता वसिष्ठेन महात्मना |
भस्मीकृता मुहूर्तेन विश्वामित्रसुतास्तदा
verses.iast:
te sa aśva ratha pādātā vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā |
bhasmī kṛtā muhūrtena viśvāmitra sutāḥ tadā
verses.translation: "That sage with vital spirit, Vashishta, then in a wink rendered those sons of Vishvamitra, along with their horses, chariots, and foot-soldiers to ashes.

glosses.meaning: by the one who has vital spirit, by Vashishta

verses.devanagari:
दृष्ट्वा विनाशितान् पुत्रान् बलं च सुमहायशाः |
सव्रीडश्चिंतयाविष्टो विश्वामित्रोऽभवत्तदा
verses.iast:
dṛṣṭvā vināśitān putrān balam ca sumahā yaśāḥ |
sa vrīḍaḥ cintayā āviṣṭo viśvāmitro abhavat tadā
verses.translation: "On seeing his sons and his forces are utterly ruined, that very highly glorious Vishvamitra was disgraced and beset by distress.

verses.devanagari:
समुद्र इव निर्वेगो भग्नदंष्ट्र इवोरगः |
उपरक्त इवादित्यः सद्यो निष्प्रभतां गतः
हतपुत्रबलो दीनो लूनपक्ष इव द्विजः |
verses.iast:
samudra iva nir.hvego bhagna daṃṣṭra iva uragaḥ |
uparakta iva ādityaḥ sadyo niṣ.hprabhatām gataḥ
hata putra balo dīno lūna pakṣa iva dvijaḥ |
verses.translation: "Like a tideless ocean his warfare did not tide him over, like a fangless serpent his hiss of warring could not fang any, like a wingless bird pitiable is his flightless plight of fightback, like a shineless sun in an eclipse, Vishvamitra plunged into a lustreless state of his own illustriousness, when his forces are ruined along with his sons.

glosses.meaning: less, coloured [shineless, while being eclipsed,] sun, as with
pitiable, clipped, wing [wingless,] bird, as with
less of, lustre, gone in - plunged into a state.

verses.devanagari:
हतसर्वबलोत्साहो निर्वेदं समपद्यत
स पुत्रमेकं राज्याय पालयेति नियुज्य च |
पृथिवीं क्षत्रधर्मेण वनमेवान्वपद्यत
verses.iast:
hata sarva bala utsāho nirvedam samapadyata
sa putram ekam rājyāya pālaya iti niyujya ca |
pṛthivīm kṣatra dharmeṇa vanam eva anvapadyata
verses.translation: "When all his intrepidity and impetuosity are ruined an indolence bechanced upon him, and then on bidding one son for the kingdom, 'you rule the earth with the duties of kingcraft...' thus saying Vishvamitra took recourse to forests.

glosses.meaning: one, son, for kingdom, on bidding

verses.devanagari:
स गत्वा हिमवत्पारर्श्वं किंनरोरगसेवितम् |
महादेवप्रसादार्थं तपस्तेपे महातपाः
verses.iast:
sa gatvā himavat pārśvam kiṃnara uraga sevitam |
mahādeva prasāda artham tapaḥ tepe mahātapāḥ
verses.translation: "On going to the mountainsides of Himalayas, whereat it is adored by kinnaraa-s and uragaa-s, the nymphs and nymphean serpents, he that great practiser of ascesis, Vishvamitra, undertook an austere ascesis for the sake of beneficence of the Great God, Shiva.

glosses.meaning: Great God's [Shiva's,] beneficence, for the sake of

verses.devanagari:
केनचित्त्वथ कालेन देवेशो वृषभध्वजः |
दर्शयामास वरदो विश्वामित्रं महामुनिम्
verses.iast:
kenacit tu atha kālena deveśo vṛṣabha dhvajaḥ |
darśayāmāsa varado viśvāmitram mahāmunim
verses.translation: "After a long lost time, Shiva, the God of Gods whose flag bears the sign of Holy Bull, has shown himself to that great-saint Vishvamitra, for He is a ready boon-giver.

glosses.meaning: at long lost, after time, but
to Vishvamitra, great-sainted darshayaamaasa = shown Himself -revealed himself.

verses.devanagari:
किमर्थं तप्यसे राजन् ब्रूहि यत्ते विवक्षितम् |
वरदोऽस्मि वरो यस्ते कांक्षितः सोऽभिधीयताम्
verses.iast:
kim artham tapyase rājan brūhi yat te vivakśitam |
varado asmi varo yaḥ te kāṅkśitaḥ so abhidhīyatām
verses.translation: " 'Oh, king, for which purpose you undertook this ascesis that you may tell me. What is it really intended by you and what boon you seek that be made known to me for I am the boon-giver.' Shiva said so to Vishvamitra.

glosses.meaning: for which, purpose, you undertook ascesis
tellable - what is intended by you

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्तस्तु देवेन विश्वामित्रो महातपाः |
प्रणिपत्य महादेवं विश्वामित्रोऽब्रवीदिदम्
verses.iast:
evam uktaḥ tu devena viśvāmitro mahātapāḥ |
praṇipatya mahādevam viśvāmitro abravīt idam
verses.translation: "Thus said by God Shiva to Vishvamitra of great ascesis, Vishvamitra on reverencing that Great God Shiva said this way.

verses.devanagari:
यदि तुष्टो महादेव धनुर्वेदो ममानघ |
साङ्गोपाङ्गोपनिषदः सरहस्यः प्रदीयताम्
verses.iast:
yadi tuṣṭo mahādeva dhanur vedo mama anagha |
sā aṅga upa aṅga upaniṣadaḥ sa rahasyaḥ pradīyatām
verses.translation: " 'Oh! Mahadeva, the Impeccable Great God... providing that you are gladdened by my ascetic devotion, dhanur veda, the Holy Writ of Archery, with its complemental and supplemental Writs, and along with its summational Upanishad-s, together with its preternatural doctrines... they may kindly be bestowed upon me...

glosses.meaning: with, complemental, supplemental Writs, summational, Writs [Upanishad-s]

verses.devanagari:
यानि देवेषु चास्त्राणि दानवेषु महर्षिषु |
गंधर्वयक्षरक्षस्सु प्रतिभांतु ममानघ
तव प्रसादाद्भवतु देवदेव ममेप्सितम् |
verses.iast:
yāni deveṣu ca astrāṇi dānaveṣu maharṣiṣu |
gandharva yakśa rakśassu pratibhāntu mama anagha
tava prasādāt bhavatu devadeva mama īpsitam |
verses.translation: " Oh, Exquisite God, whichever missile is there either with gods, or fiends, gandharva-s, yaksha-s, and demons, let it dawn upon me. For you alone are the God of Gods your blessings alone can fulfil my aspiration.' Thus Vishvamitra entreated God Shiva.

glosses.meaning: my, aspiration, become - let it be fulfilled.

verses.devanagari: एवमस्त्विति देवेशो वाक्यमुक्त्वा गतस्तदा
verses.iast: evam astu iti deveśo vākyam uktvā gataḥ tadā
verses.translation: " 'So be it!' On sanctifying Vishvamitra and his aspiration thus, the God of Gods, Shiva disappeared.

verses.devanagari:
प्राप्य चास्त्राणि देवेशाद्विश्वामित्रो महाबलः |
दर्पेण महता युक्तो दर्पपूर्णोऽभवत्तदा
verses.iast:
prāpya ca astrāṇi deveśāt viśvāmitro mahābalaḥ |
darpeṇa mahatā yukto darpapūrṇo abhavat tadā
verses.translation: "Vishvamitra who is already a mightier Kshatriya, now on acquiring missiles from the God of Gods, Shiva, will he not come forth paired up with mightiest conceit, and then will not his conceitedness be plethoric like a plethoric ocean?

verses.devanagari:
विवर्धमानो वीर्येण समुद्र इव पर्वणि |
हतं मेने तदा राम वसिष्ठमृषिसत्तमम्
verses.iast:
vivardhamāno vīryeṇa samudra iva par.hvaṇi |
hatam mene tadā rāma vasiṣṭham ṛṣi sattamam
verses.translation: "By vitality Vishvamitra is like an ocean with rough riptide on a Full Moon day, and oh, Rama, he deemed that sagaciously mighty sage Vashishta is now 'dead.'

glosses.meaning: on an auspicious day [in Full Moon day]

verses.devanagari:
ततो गत्वाश्रमपदं मुमोचास्त्राणि पार्थिवः |
यैस्तत्तपोवनं सर्वं निर्दग्धं चास्त्रतेजसा
verses.iast:
tato gatvā āśramapadam mumoca astrāṇi pārthivaḥ |
yaiḥ tat tapo vanam sarvam nir.hdagdham ca astra tejasā
verses.translation: Then on going to the threshold of Vashishta 's hermitage that king propelled his missiles, by the holocaust of which missiles that ascetic woodland is completely burnt down in its entirety.

glosses.meaning: to hermitage's threshold [of Vashishta,] on going

verses.devanagari:
उदीर्यमाणमस्त्रं तद्विश्वामित्रस्य धीमतः |
दृष्ट्वा विप्रद्रुता भीता मुनयः शतशो दिशः
verses.iast:
udīryamāṇam astram tat viśvāmitrasya dhīmataḥ |
dṛṣṭvā vipradrutā bhītā munayaḥ śataśo diśaḥ
verses.translation: "On seeing the turbo-jetting missiles of Vishvamitra jetted by his sparkling intellect, hundreds of saints were frightened and they very speedily fled in hundreds of ways.

verses.devanagari:
वसिष्ठस्य च ये शिष्याः ये च वै मृगपक्षिणः |
विद्रवन्ति भयाद्भीता नाना दिग्भ्यः सहस्रशः
verses.iast:
vasiṣṭhasya ca ye śiṣyāḥ ye ca vai mṛga pakśiṇaḥ |
vidravanti bhayāt bhītā nānā dik.hbhyaḥ sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: "Whoever is the disciple of Vashishta and whichever is either animal or a bird, all are utterly frightened and thousands of them have hastily fled to numerous directions.

verses.devanagari:
वसिष्ठस्याश्रमपदं शून्यमासीन्महात्मनः |
मुहूर्तमिव निःशब्दमासीदिरिणसंनिभम्
verses.iast:
vasiṣṭhasya āśramapadam śūnyam āsīt mahātmanaḥ |
muhūrtam iva niḥśabdam āsīt īriṇa saṃnibham
verses.translation: "The threshold of that broad-minded Vashishta's hermitage fell void, and in a wink it has become silent like a burial ground as every shrub, herb and tree is cindery, and every bird, animal and stock is an evacuee.

glosses.meaning: vasiSThasya aashrama padam = of broad-minded sage, Vashishta 's, hermitage, threshold

verses.devanagari:
वदतो वै वसिष्ठस्य मा भैष्टेति मुहुर्मुहुः |
नाशयाम्यद्य गाधेयं नीहारमिव भास्करः
verses.iast:
vadato vai vasiṣṭhasya mā bhai iti muhur.hmuhuḥ |
nāśayāmi adya gādheyam nīhāram iva bhāskaraḥ
verses.translation: "Although Vashishta shouted at them saying time and again, 'do not fear, do not fear... now I will dissipate that son of Gaadhi, Vishvamitra, like Sun demisting the mist,' all the inmates of hermitage have hastily fled.

glosses.meaning: Sun, to mist, as with - like sun demisting the mist
[although] saying [shouting at the fleeing inmates of hermitage, they have

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्त्वा महातेजा वसिष्ठो जपतां वरः |
विश्वामित्रं तदा वाक्यं सरोषमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
evam uktvā mahātejā vasiṣṭho japatām varaḥ |
viśvāmitram tadā vākyam sa roṣam idam abravīt
verses.translation: "On saying that way to the evacuees, Vashishta, the great-resplendent sage and a best one among best meditators rancorously said this word to Vishvamitra.

glosses.meaning: great-resplendent, among best meditators, the best one, Vashishta

verses.devanagari:
आश्रमं चिरसंवृद्धं यद्विनाशितवानसि |
दुराचारो हि यन्मूढ तस्मात्त्वं न भविष्यसि
verses.iast:
āśramam cira saṃvṛddham yat vināśitavān asi |
durācāro hi yat mūḍha tasmāt tvam na bhaviṣyasi
verses.translation: " 'You senseless king, by which reason you have havocked this hermitage that is well nourished for a long time by me, for that reason you have become a reprehensible one, and thereby you will not survive any longer.
notes: Vividly: 'when I have sensibly nourished the trees, birds and animals or disciples, saints and sages, in indoctrinating them the true dharma 'righteous duty...' observable by each of the birthed being, what necessitated you to harm the harmless 'fly anywhere' birds, 'new to world' calves and 'take what you need' trees and animals... you should have confronted me headlong, instead... but you on seeing such a beatitude of this hermitage, you have become envious in your self-aggrandisement... and as said in an old saying like, 'a senseless reprehensible being, may it be a human, animal, bird, or a reptile is unfit to survive for long...' you are now transposable with such a senseless being by this act of yours, which you have undertaken with the notion of 'survival of the fittest...' thereby I will now show you who is fit enough to survive, an instructor or an intruder, in effacing your survival...'

glosses.meaning: for a long time, well, nourished, hermitage
badly, in conduct [reprehensible one,] indeed you are

verses.devanagari:
इत्युक्त्वा परमक्रुद्धो दण्डमुद्यम्य सत्वरः |
विधूम इव कालाग्निर्यमदण्डमिवापरम्
verses.iast:
iti uktvā parama kruddho daṇḍam udyaṃya satvaraḥ |
vidhūma iva kāla agniḥ yama daṇḍam iva aparam
verses.translation: "On saying thus that extremely infuriated Sage Vashishta post-hastily up-heaved his baton, which is alike the fumeless Ultimate Fire of End Time, and the other baton of Yama, the Terminator, and affronted Vishvamitra." Thus, Sage Shataananda continued his narration of Vishvamitra's legend.

glosses.meaning: without, fumes, Time, Fire, as with
another, Yama's, baton, which is like
